county_page.evidence: The Abfallentsorgung page states 'Die Tourenpläne für die Entsorgung von Restmüll, Papier, Sperrmüll ... sind in der Abfallfibel ersichtlich', and the news item 'Abfallfibel 2026' (08.12.2025) announces the new Fibel. Past Fibeln are PDFs under /media/custom/.

counties.note: Abfallwirtschaft Landkreis Sonneberg (abfallwirtschaft-sonneberg.de, linked from kreis-sonneberg.de) has an Ort > Ortsteil > Straße Abfallkalender covering all 8 municipalities, with PDF and iCal export.

county_page.evidence: The page has 'Bitte Ort wählen' with Schalkau, Föritztal, Frankenblick, Goldisthal, Lauscha, Neuhaus am Rennweg, Steinach and Sonneberg, plus buttons 'Abfallkalender erstellen (PDF)' and 'Kalender exportieren (iCal)'.

counties.note: Eigenbetrieb Kommunale Dienste Suhl (ebkds.de) links 'Abfallkalender Online' at ebkds.hausmuell.info (aturis/EKO vendor, also an app), which offers an ICS download.

page.evidence: The EBKDS menu 'Service > Abfallkalender online' links to ebkds.hausmuell.info, which shows Stadt Suhl with a Restabfall/Gelbe Tonne/Papier/Bio choice and '.ics Datei für Outlook Kalender'.

counties.note: Kommunaler Abfallservice Landkreis Gotha embeds the AWIDO calendar (client 'gotha'), which has ICS download. All four input towns are there, but as 'Drei Gleichen OT …', 'Nesse-Apfelstädt OT …', 'Hörsel OT …' and 'Tonna OT …' entries, which is probably why they did not match an existing vendor.

county_page.evidence: The page embeds https://awido.cubefour.de/Customer/gotha/v3/Calendar2.aspx ('Bitte Ort wählen', 'Termine als ICS laden'). AWIDO getPlaces for gotha lists Drei Gleichen OT Wechmar etc., Nesse-Apfelstädt OT Neudietendorf etc., Hörsel OT Aspach etc., and Tonna OT Burgtonna/Gräfentonna.

counties.note: The Landkreis Saalekreis contracts collection to its own company. The official page saalekreis.de/de/abfallentsorgungstermine.html redirects (302) to the Müllabfuhr-Deutschland portal, where the calendar module has 'ICS exportieren' and 'PDF exportieren'. The county also publishes a Tourenplan 2026 PDF.

county_page.evidence: saalekreis.de 'Ihre Abfallentsorgungstermine' redirects to portal.muellabfuhr-deutschland.de/saalekreis/kalender, whose calendar module offers 'ICS exportieren' and 'Kalender als ICS-Datei exportieren'. The town list was not visible because the page is a single-page app.

counties.note: The Kreiswirtschaftsbetrieb Salzlandkreis (KWB, a county Eigenbetrieb, linked from salzlandkreis.de) runs its own calendar app on kwb-slk.de. Its places list of 159 Orte covers Bernburg, Schönebeck, Aschersleben, Staßfurt, Güsten, Egeln and the other towns, and it has an .ics download.

county_page.evidence: The Abfall-Tourenplan page says to pick your Ort (and street in larger towns) and that the calendar view generates an ICS file. The app's JS downloads '<place>.ics', and /kalender/places lists 159 Orte across the county.

counties.note: Abfallwirtschaft Sachsen-Anhalt Süd AöR (AW SAS) collects for the Burgenlandkreis only, and burgenlandkreis.de links to awsas.de. Its Abfallkalender uses the Müllabfuhr-Deutschland app/portal.

county_page.evidence: The page tells residents to enter their Ortsteil or Stadt, and a street if needed, and offers a PDF download or saving 'direkt als iCal-Datei' into their calendar, for waste collection in the Burgenlandkreis.

counties.note: Kommunalservice Landkreis Börde AöR (ks-boerde.de, linked from landkreis-boerde.de under Beteiligungen) collects. Its form, a hausmuell.info/EKO backend, takes Ort, Ortsteil, Straße and Hausnummer and offers HTML, PDF and an ICS 'Outlook-Kalender' output.

county_page.evidence: The Entsorgungstermine page has an address form (Ort, Ortsteil, Straße, Hausnummer) with the buttons 'Aktualisieren', 'Druckversion (PDF)' and 'Outlook-Kalender' (send_form_ics).

counties.note: Anhalt-Bitterfelder Kreiswerke GmbH (ABIKW) collects, and anhalt-bitterfeld.de links to abikw.de/abfalltourenplan. The page embeds a GeMoS WasteBox TourSchedule widget, whose Ort list spans Aken, Bitterfeld, Köthen, Zerbst, Zörbig, Raguhn and others.

county_page.evidence: abikw.de/abfalltourenplan embeds abikw.wastebox.gemos-management.de. After choosing Ort and street (tested with Aken, Ackerstraße), the result offers 'Exportieren iCal' with an Abfuhrtermine.ics download and a subscribe URL.

counties.note: The Eigenbetrieb Abfallwirtschaft Mansfeld-Südharz (EAW) publishes Tourenplan 2026 as an embedded GeMoS WasteBox widget. Its Ort list includes Lutherstadt Eisleben, Sangerhausen, Hettstedt, Kelbra and Wimmelburg.

county_page.evidence: The EAW Tourenplan page embeds eaw.wastebox.gemos-management.de/TourSchedule.js. The widget's Ort/Ortsteil dropdown covers the county, and a result view (Allstedt) contains the Print/ics export links.

counties.note: The Landkreis Wittenberg's Abfallwirtschaft publishes 'Abfallkalender online' through the Müllabfuhr-Deutschland WordPress plugin (Gemeinde, then Ortschaft, then Abholtermine). It covers all nine member towns, and the toolbar downloads ICS from portal.muellabfuhr-deutschland.de.

county_page.evidence: The page says 'Bitte wählen Sie Ihre Gemeinde aus... Ortschaft... Abholterminen' for Annaburg through Zahna-Elster, and its mad-pickup-toolbar.js has an ICS download (api-portal/mandators/31/.../pickups/ics).

counties.note: ALS Dienstleistungsgesellschaft collects for the Landkreis Stendal, and landkreis-stendal.de names it. Its Entsorgungstermine page embeds the abfall-app.net tenant 'Abfall-App Landkreis Stendal', which offers a PDF of the whole year and a 'Kalenderimport' iCal download.

county_page.evidence: als-stendal.de/entsorgungstermine embeds an iframe of landkreis-stendal.abfall-app.net, whose app.js offers 'Jahresübersicht als PDF' and 'Kalenderimport' (ical download link). The town list was not visible because the page is a single-page app.

counties.note: The Landkreis Jerichower Land runs waste collection itself (Öffentliche Abfallwirtschaft). Its Tourenplan 2026 tool on lkjl.de covers all eight Einheitsgemeinden, and you pick Gemeinde, then Ortsteil, then Straße.

county_page.evidence: The Tourenplan 2026 page has a three-step picker (Biederitz, Burg, Elbe-Parey, Genthin, Gommern, Jerichow, Möckern, Möser, then Ortsteil, then Straße) and offers the result as a PDF or an iCal export.

counties.note: The Altmarkkreis Salzwedel publishes one Abfall-App for the whole county on the abfall-app.net vendor. Its own abfallkalender.aspx sends a 302 redirect straight to that app.

county_page.evidence: The app's embedded city list has Gardelegen, Kalbe (Milde), Salzwedel, Dähre, Diesdorf, Jübar, Kuhfelde, Rohrberg, Wallstawe, Apenburg-Winterfeld, Beetzendorf, Arendsee and Klötze, each with districts and streets, and its JS offers PDF and 'Kalenderimport' (touren.ics).

counties.note: The Stadtpflege Dessau-Roßlau, the city's own municipal operation, collects household waste. Its Abfallkalender page has a street search, and each street's result page links an .ics download.

county_page.evidence: The page has a 'bitte Straße eingeben' search. The result page ?ID=446 lists the dates for graue and grüne Tonne and has an 'Outlook-Kalender herunterladen' link to /cms/wp-content/tmp/446.ics, and yearly PDFs are also offered.

counties.note: enwi (Entsorgungswirtschaft des Landkreises Harz AöR) collects for the whole Landkreis. Its Entsorgungstermine page embeds a Jumomind web module whose locality list has the Ortsteile of Oberharz am Brocken, Nordharz, Huy, Falkenstein/Harz and Selke-Aue (for example Elbingerode, Derenburg, Dingelstedt, Ermsleben, Hausneindorf).

county_page.publisher: enwi Entsorgungswirtschaft des Landkreises Harz AöR
county_page.evidence: The page iframes https://enwi.jumomind.com/webmodul/enwi/. That module's cities API returns 149 Harz localities, and its HTML contains iCal/ICS export options.

counties.note: The Landkreis Mecklenburgische Seenplatte runs its own Abfuhrkalender module on the district website (ModID=48): pick a town from 149 locations, including Neubrandenburg and Waren, then a street or Ortsteil. The result links an iCal export (/output/options.php?...call=ical). The 'MSE Abfall' app is offered as well.

county_page.evidence: The page has a form with a locid dropdown of 149 towns (Neubrandenburg, Waren, Alt Schwerin ...) and street autocomplete. A query for Alt Schwerin returned 2026 dates and an href '/output/options.php?ModID=48&call=ical&...'.

counties.note: The district-owned VEVG (Ver- und Entsorgungsgesellschaft des Landkreises Vorpommern-Greifswald mbH), which kreis-vg.de/Landkreis/Abfallwirtschaft names, publishes online calendars for four areas: OVP, JTPL, UHGW (Greifswald city, by street) and UER. The residents' entry page lists the four; each area's calendar page (online-abfallkalender-<area>.html) takes a town or street and offers an iCal download.

county_page.publisher: Ver- und Entsorgungsgesellschaft des Landkreises Vorpommern-Greifswald mbH (VEVG)
county_page.evidence: The page links the four area calendars (OVP, JTPL, UHGW, UER). On the UER calendar, choosing Viereck returned 'Abfuhrtermine 2026' and 'Hier stehen Ihnen die Abfuhrtermine im iCalendar-Datenformat zum Import in Ihren Kalender zur Verfügung'. The UHGW calendar lists Greifswald streets.

counties.note: The Eigenbetrieb Abfallwirtschaft Landkreis Rostock runs abfall-lro.de, which landkreis-rostock.de links. Residents choose their town from an A-Z list and get a PDF or an iCal download. Güstrow has its own street-level page (/de/abfuhrtermine/guestrow.php), also with PDF and iCal. ALBA Nord does the collection.

county_page.evidence: The Leerungstermine page lists towns A-Z with 2026 PDFs, has a form posting to /default-wGlobal/wGlobal/abfuhrtermine/ical.php, and states that dates can be 'als Kalender (iCal) in ein Kalender-Programm herunter[ge]laden' werden. Güstrow has its own street page with the same PDF and iCal options.

counties.note: Eigenbetrieb Abfallwirtschaft (AWI) des Landkreises Vorpommern-Rügen publishes one online Abfallkalender for all three Entsorgungsgebiete (Hansestadt Stralsund, Nordvorpommern, Rügen), built into the Landkreis site. It exports ICS, PDF and CSV, and there is also an Abfall-App.

county_page.evidence: On the page the resident picks a location and waste types, then clicks 'Datei exportieren' to get ICS ('Mit dem Dateiformat ICS können Sie Ihre Abfuhrtermine ... in Ihren persönlichen Kalender laden'), PDF or CSV. It names the areas Hansestadt Stralsund, Nordvorpommern and Rügen.

counties.note: Abfallwirtschaft Ludwigslust-Parchim AöR (alp-lup.de, linked from kreis-lup.de) runs one Abfallkalender for the whole county. You choose the Wohnort and, where needed, the street. It offers iCal files from Gemos GmbH, a PDF print version and e-mail reminders.

county_page.evidence: The page tells residents to pick 'Ihren Wohnort und gegebenenfalls die jeweilige Straße' and says the dates are 'auch als iCal-Kalenderdatei (ics) zur Verfügung', alongside a PDF print version. The county's own site kreis-lup.de redirects its Abfallwirtschaft link to alp-lup.de.

counties.note: The AWB Nordwestmecklenburg serves every town except Hansestadt Wismar. The Landkreis's 'Abfuhrtermine Online' link redirects to the county Geoportal: you search your Ortsteil and get PDF calendars plus ICS files. Wismar is collected by its own EVB (Entsorgungs- und Verkehrsbetrieb), which has a street search.

county_page.evidence: The page shows 'Abfuhrtermine 2026 für den Landkreis Nordwestmecklenburg' with an Ortsteil search. Its result template offers 'öffnen (PDF)' calendars and 'downloaden (ICS)' calendar files. nordwestmecklenburg.de/de/abfuhrtermine-online-1.html redirects here.

page.publisher: Entsorgungs- und Verkehrsbetrieb der Hansestadt Wismar (EVB)
page.evidence: The page says 'Erfahren Sie hier die Abfuhrtermine für Ihre Straße!' and has a street search ('Geben Sie einfach den Namen Ihrer Straße ohne Hausnummer ein'). I saw no ICS or PDF export in the fetched content. The Landkreis names EVB as the operator for Wismar.

counties.note: Schwerin's collection calendar comes from SDS (Stadtwirtschaftliche Dienstleistungen Schwerin, Eigenbetrieb der Landeshauptstadt). It is a Gemos WasteBox street-selection widget embedded on sds-schwerin.de. SAS Schwerin also points residents to it and offers a PDF and the 'Abfallkalender Schwerin' app.

county_page.publisher: SDS - Stadtwirtschaftliche Dienstleistungen Schwerin (Eigenbetrieb der Landeshauptstadt Schwerin)
county_page.evidence: The page embeds the widget sds.wastebox.gemos-management.de/.../TourSchedule/Embedded/, which has a 'Straße:' dropdown listing Schwerin streets. The initial HTML showed no ICS/iCal export; the result view was not inspected. sas-schwerin.de/abfallkalender links to this Entsorgungskalender.

counties.note: The Entsorgungsverband Saar (EVS) publishes one Müllmax street calendar for 42 Saarland municipalities. Saarlouis and Lebach are not in it: Saarlouis runs its own calendar on mein-abfallkalender.online (Krissel), and Lebach's is run by the Lebacher Abfallzweckverband.

county_page.evidence: The EVS Abfuhrtermine page links evs.muellmax.de. Its Wohnort dropdown lists Bous, Dillingen, Ensdorf, Nalbach, Rehlingen-Siersburg, Saarwellingen, Schmelz, Schwalbach, Überherrn, Wadgassen and Wallerfangen, and the result for Kantstraße 66359 Bous offers an 'iCalendar-Datei' option.

page.evidence: The page is run by Kreisstadt Saarlouis and offers street selection plus a 'Termine (iCal / WebCal)' button. The EVS page says Saarlouis provides its own calendar and links this URL.

The Lebach page lists collection districts (for example Lebach Nord Bezirk 1), each with a street overview and calendars to download. It names the Lebacher Abfallzweckverband and shows no iCal option.

counties.note: EVS Müllmax covers Heusweiler, Püttlingen, Sulzbach, Riegelsberg, Quierschied, Kleinblittersdorf, Friedrichsthal and Großrosseln. Völklingen is served by the Entsorgungszweckverband Völklingen (EZV).

county_page.evidence: The Müllmax Wohnort dropdown lists Heusweiler, Püttlingen, Sulzbach, Riegelsberg, Quierschied, Kleinblittersdorf, Friedrichsthal and Großrosseln, and the street result offers an 'iCalendar-Datei' option.

page.evidence: The EZV Abfuhrtermine page offers the Abfuhrkalender 2026 as a PDF and a district PDF. It also links an 'individueller Abfuhrkalender' in the Bürgerportal (buerger-portal-voelklingen.azurewebsites.net), a script-only app whose format could not be checked.

counties.note: EVS Müllmax covers Blieskastel, Bexbach, Mandelbachtal, Kirkel and Gersheim. Homburg and St. Ingbert collect themselves, and both use Krissel's mein-abfallkalender.online.

county_page.evidence: The Müllmax Wohnort dropdown lists Blieskastel, Bexbach, Mandelbachtal, Kirkel and Gersheim, and the street result offers an 'iCalendar-Datei' option.

page.evidence: The page embeds homburg.mein-abfallkalender.online/app/termine.html for picking a street. The sister page MüllMemo says the individual date list can be downloaded as iCal or subscribed to via WebCal.
st-ingbert.de/abfall links this online Abfallkalender. It lists every street with its district (for example Adam-Berberich-Straße, Hassel) and carries WebCal/iCal import instructions.

counties.note: EVS Müllmax covers Illingen, Schiffweiler, Ottweiler, Spiesen-Elversberg and Merchweiler. Neunkirchen collects itself, with a PDF and the iGudd app. Eppelborn is served by the Abfallzweckverband Eppelborn (AFZE).

county_page.evidence: The Müllmax Wohnort dropdown lists Illingen, Schiffweiler, Ottweiler, Spiesen-Elversberg and Merchweiler, and the street result offers an 'iCalendar-Datei' option.

page.evidence: The city page offers the Abfuhr-Kalender 2026 as an A4 PDF and points to the iGudd app for dates on the phone. It shows no web street search and no iCal option.

The AFZE page lists nine districts (Bubach, Dirmingen, Eppelborn Nord and others). It says each calendar was made in Google Calendar and can be added to the resident's own calendar on phone or computer.

counties.note: EVS Müllmax covers Losheim am See, Wadern, Beckingen, Mettlach, Perl and Weiskirchen. Merzig collects itself and uses mein-abfallkalender.online.

county_page.evidence: The Müllmax Wohnort dropdown lists Losheim am See, Wadern, Beckingen, Mettlach, Perl and Weiskirchen, and the street result offers an 'iCalendar-Datei' option.

page.evidence: The Merzig page links street selection at merzig.mein-abfallkalender.online/app/strassenauswahl.html, a PDF calendar, and an 'Abfallkalender als iCal-Datei' page.

counties.note: EVS Müllmax covers Tholey, Marpingen, Nohfelden, Nonnweiler, Freisen, Namborn and Oberthal. St. Wendel is served by its own Umweltamt through a C-Trace street search.

county_page.evidence: The Müllmax Wohnort dropdown lists Tholey, Marpingen, Nohfelden, Nonnweiler, Freisen, Namborn and Oberthal, and the street result offers an 'iCalendar-Datei' option.

page.evidence: This C-Trace page asks for a street and house number and names the Umweltamt der Kreisstadt St. Wendel. The fetched page showed no iCal export, and the EVS page links it for St. Wendel.

counties.note: Landratsamt Enzkreis (Abfallwirtschaft) is responsible for all 28 municipalities. Its Entsorgungsplattform abfallwirtschaft-enzkreis.de, built by UDATA, has a town dropdown, iCal export, email reminders, PDFs and the Enzkreis-App.

county_page.evidence: The Leerungstermine page has a dropdown with all 28 Enzkreis municipalities (Birkenfeld … Wurmberg) and offers 'Leerungstermine als ics-Export (iCal)'.

counties.note: Landratsamt Schwäbisch Hall collects waste in all municipalities. Its Abfuhrtermine page uses an Abfall+ (abfallplus) widget: residents pick a Wohnort, plus a street in Crailsheim, Schwäbisch Hall and Gaildorf.

county_page.evidence: Page says to choose your Wohnort (and street for Crailsheim, Schwäbisch Hall, Gaildorf) and that dates can be exported 'als ICS-Datei direkt in Ihren Online-Kalender'; the widget is from Abfall+.

counties.note: Landratsamt Zollernalbkreis (Abfallwirtschaftsamt) collects waste in all 25 municipalities. The electronic Abfallkalender is an abfall.io (Abfall+) widget embedded on zollernalbkreis.de, and there is also the ABFALL ZAK app.

county_page.evidence: The page embeds the api.abfall.io widget, asks residents to choose their address and waste types, and offers the calendar as a PDF or 'zum Importieren in Ihren digitalen Kalender'.

counties.note: The Eigenbetrieb Abfallwirtschaft Landkreis Waldshut collects waste in all municipalities, split into collection areas West and East. The Termine page offers an address lookup, an iCal download or subscription, a PDF and an app.

county_page.evidence: The Termine page lists collection areas covering Waldshut-Tiengen, Bad Säckingen, Wehr, Bonndorf and others, and offers an iCal file download, a free iCal subscription and a PDF for your address.

counties.note: Landratsamt Emmendingen (Abfallwirtschaft) collects waste in all 24 municipalities, and Emmendingen city has district PDFs (e.g. emoberstadtunterstadt.pdf). The personal calendar is an Abfallplus iframe behind a cookie consent.

county_page.evidence: The page offers 'Ihr persönlicher Abfallkalender 2026' as an embedded Abfallplus widget plus per-town PDFs for all municipalities. The county's news item says the personal calendar is output 'als PDF-Datei … oder als ICS-Datei zum Importieren'.
